headlines.title: Why the traditional 60/40 portfolio might be dead
headlines.summary: Catalyst Funds Chief Investment Officer David Miller and Washington Crossing Advisors Senior Portfolio Manager Chad Morganlander chat about the reality of the 60/40 portfolio in today's volatile economy, and break down why traditional investing strategies might fail you as interest rates rise and the national debt skyrockets.

headlines.title: Automatic Data Processing (ADP): Is Its Payroll Moat and Float Windfall Built to Last?
headlines.summary: Automatic Data Processing, Inc. (NASDAQ:ADP) runs payroll and human-resources software for hundreds of thousands of businesses. ADP holds tens of billions of dollars of client payroll money in transit and earns interest on it.

headlines.title: Automatic Data Processing vs. Lumentum: Which Technology Stock Is a Better Buy in 2026?
headlines.summary: ADP offers steady dividend growth and record client satisfaction across a global payroll business. Lumentum is growing at a remarkable pace on AI demand but carries customer concentration risk worth understanding.

headlines.title: Does ADP’s Slower Pays-Per-Control Growth and Resilient Revenue Mix Change The Bull Case For ADP (ADP)?
headlines.summary: In recent months, Automatic Data Processing reported a sharp slowdown in pays-per-control growth to about 1% for fiscal 2026 and guided to 0–1% for fiscal 2027, signaling a cooler U.S. labor market alongside expectations for slightly weaker client retention.

headlines.title: Job postings are on the rise despite shrinking labor force
headlines.summary: Yahoo Finance Senior Columnist Kerry Hannon joins Market Domination host Ines Ferré to report that job postings are up for the first time since 2022, and that the ADP National Employment report showed the private-sector labor market added 90,000 jobs in September.

description: Automatic Data Processing, Inc. provides cloud-based human capital management (HCM) solutions worldwide. It operates in two segments, Employer Services and Professional Employer Organization (PEO). The Employer Services segment offers strategic, cloud-based platforms, and human resources (HR) outsourcing solutions. This segment's offerings include RUN Powered by ADP, a software platform for small business payroll, HR, and compliance; ADP Workforce Now, a HCM solution used across mid-sized and large businesses to manage employees; and ADP Lyric HCM, a solution for HR management, payroll, workforce management, talent, and data analytics. Its PEO Services segment provides HR outsourcing solutions under ADP TotalSource name to businesses through a co-employment model. This segment also provides guidance, user-friendly technology, comprehensive employee benefits, and a risk management, safety, and workers' compensation program. The company was founded in 1949 and is headquartered in Roseland, New Jersey.
